title: Game-Day Workout
description: A light 20-minute game-day tune-up: rhythm shooting, touch finishes, and free throws — sharpens feel without tiring your legs.

items.name: Form shooting
items.detail: Easy one-hand form shots close to the rim: 10 makes. Loose, relaxed, find your touch.

items.name: Spot shooting
items.detail: Midrange spots you will shoot tonight: 3 makes per spot, game-speed footwork, no rushing.

items.name: Game-spot threes
items.detail: Threes from your real game spots only: 2 makes per spot. See the ball go through the net.

items.name: Touch finishes
items.detail: Easy layups both hands, a few floaters — no contact, no jumping max. Just feel.

items.name: Free throws
items.detail: 10 free throws with your exact game routine. End on a swish.

items.name: Visualization
items.detail: Stand at half-court, close your eyes, and picture 3 successful plays from tonight's game.

tips: Game day is about confidence, not conditioning — if your legs feel heavy, you did too much.
Shoot only from spots you will actually get in the game tonight.
End every shooting block on a make. Your last rep is what your brain remembers.
Stay off your feet after the workout — save your legs for tip-off.
